title: A Space that chose the Default theme shows its published kit pages

source.ref: LIVE-1470 follow-up: Default kits are stored as the DAWN editor theme, which the public site never served.

detail: publishedWebsiteSnapshot now serves a published DAWN document when the Space's Mega Theme choice (preferences.megaTheme.theme) is 'frequency'. A Space with no stored choice, or only a niche, keeps the house Default look exactly as before, so no existing site changes. The document must still match the theme the site wears.

verify.evidence: state.test.ts covers no choice, niche only, chosen Default, and a mismatched theme.
